Favoured weapon: Spear

Granted power: Advantage on Intimidation. Once/day: when your Smite hits, the target also makes a Will save or is Frightened of you until the end of its next turn.

Allegiance: Chaotic Evil, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Gruumsh in the World of Arneyan wiki.
